root_causes.title: Medians over all available values, not paired-only
root_causes.summary: The table footnotes give paired-value counts (16, 17, 22), so all three agents computed medians only over participants with both visits. The published medians are instead taken over every value available at each visit, which adds participant 15 (FVC lying, follow-up only) and participant 20 (timed tests and chair rise, follow-up only). This one reading reproduces all 28 median cells: 56 -> 54, 0.52 -> 0.42 (0.4) and 7.8 -> 9.8, and it also fixes FVC sitting at 6 years (65 -> 63.5, published 64).
root_causes.suggested_wording: Medians at each visit were computed over all participants with a value at that visit (so n can exceed the number of paired values given in the footnotes), whereas Wilcoxon tests used only participants with paired values.

root_causes.title: Missing-baseline handling in the velocity SRMs
root_causes.summary: The Methods give no missing-data rule. Read as paired participants only (22, as the footnote says), the four velocity SRMs come out at -0.49, -1.16, -0.47 and -0.49. Counting the one participant with no baseline value as 0 (n = 23) gives -0.48, -1.02, -0.46 and -0.47, the published values. This single reading moves all four cells onto the published numbers.
root_causes.suggested_wording: SRMs for the velocity tests were calculated over all 23 participants, with a missing baseline velocity entered as 0, whereas medians and Wilcoxon tests used the 22 participants with paired values.

root_causes.title: Small Wilcoxon P residuals with no reproducing reading
root_causes.summary: We tried asymptotic vs exact, continuity correction, wilcox/pratt/zsplit zero handling, participant-20 handling, re-expressing velocities as times, leave-one-out, and small perturbations of the deposited values. None of them reproduces these four P values together without breaking others. Strength P values (0.14 vs 0.13, 0.16 vs 0.15) move away from the published values under every variant, and TUG matches only under a Pratt plus n=23 combination that worsens two other rows. Stair-descent P is consistent with the deposited velocities being given to only 2 decimals, but that cannot be confirmed.
root_causes.suggested_wording: Wilcoxon signed-rank P values were computed in SPSS v24 (asymptotic, zero differences excluded, no continuity correction) on the original measurements; the deposited velocities are given to 2 decimals and may give slightly different P values.

best_example.why: One unstated choice, whether medians use every value at a visit or only paired participants, accounts for three missed cells (including chair rise at 6 years, 7.8 s vs 9.8 s), and a single sentence of Methods would have let all 28 median cells be reproduced exactly.
